labels_checked.label: prop:BTZ_virt_tame
labels_checked.notes: Statement: GX.btzE0_virt_tame is IsVirtuallyTame for the paper's E0 (alpha = 2pi, x0 = 0, v = (-1,1,0), btzE0Structure) with NO hypothesis; GX.btz_virt_tame generalises to every x0, every v with 0 < v.2.1 (<v|u> < 0) and every alpha != 0, a strengthening. Its hypotheses hv, halpha, hpi = IsBTZStructure x0 v alpha are satisfiable (exists_isBTZStructure; discharged in btzE0_virt_tame) and do not carry the conclusion (IsBTZStructure only says the projection from the cylinder, with the structure developed by D on {r>0}, is an a.e. morphism: the definition of E0's structure, unique by isBTZStructure_unique). IsVirtuallyTame / IsTamifyingTopology (SingularII/Models l.1442-1487) checked against def:singular_manifold_virtually_tame (l.1960): T <= weakTopMax is Mathlib's 'finer', i.e. the paper's 'thinner'; first countable; locally path connected; (A) coinduced along SpreadEnd.base = the topology of M; (B) a T-continuous D whose restriction to p^-1(Reg) is a regular morphism for p^*B; (C) every deck map T-continuous; (D) p^-1(Reg) T-portly (GX.IsPortly: open, dense, locally connected in). T = induced Phi hornTop with Phi a natural homeomorphism MaxBranchedCover ~ DInfty x R (btz_exists_homeomorph, built from previous_examples_maxBranched, not assumed); hornTop = natural inf generateFrom {r theta^2 < l, l > 0} (hornTop_eq_btzGenTop, hornFn = r * theta^2), which is l.1953/2245's 'generated by the natural topology and the U_lambda' (Mathlib's inf of topologies is generated by the union of the open sets). D-6 confirmed and repaired: the printed 'contains {r < lambda/4pi^2} and is thus open' is a non sequitur; (A) is proved instead by 'a Gamma-invariant tamTop-open set is naturally open' (coinduced_orbitMk_tamTop, SpreadTop l.3494, sorry-free), so the statement stands and the proof repair does not make the row partial. (B), (C), (D), which the paper asserts without proof in sec:mot_BTZ, are all proved. Readings: D-5 (theta in R rather than theta/2pi) and the metric's 'r^2 dtheta' read 'r^2 dtheta^2'; both are settled by the paper's own explicit D (l.1947), whose pullback is proved to be -2dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 at every point (btzPaperDev_pullback; checked by hand: with t = tau + r theta^2/2, x = t - r, y = -r theta, -dt^2 + dx^2 + dy^2 = -2 dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2), and the charts of the structure are local isometries of the printed metric (btz_chart_pullback). See minor 1 for the absence of an explicit ruling.
